mcq.q: A square is covered with 3 rows of 3 unit squares. What is its area?
mcq.explanation: Area = 3 × 3 = 9 square units.

mcq.q: A square is covered with 6 rows of 6 unit squares. What is its area?
mcq.explanation: Area = 6 × 6 = 36 square units.

mcq.q: A square is covered with 10 rows of 10 unit squares. What is its area?
mcq.explanation: Area = 10 × 10 = 100 square units.

mcq.q: A square is covered with 5 rows of 5 unit squares. What is its area?
mcq.explanation: Area = 5 × 5 = 25 square units.

mcq.q: A square is covered with 8 rows of 8 unit squares. What is its area?
mcq.explanation: Area = 8 × 8 = 64 square units.

mcq.q: Rectangle P has 5 rows and 7 columns. Rectangle Q has 6 rows and 6 columns. Which has the bigger area?
mcq.explanation: P = 5 × 7 = 35 and Q = 6 × 6 = 36. Rectangle Q has the bigger area.

mcq.q: Rectangle P has 4 rows and 9 columns. Rectangle Q has 5 rows and 8 columns. Which has the bigger area?
mcq.explanation: P = 4 × 9 = 36 and Q = 5 × 8 = 40. Rectangle Q has the bigger area.

mcq.q: Rectangle P has 3 rows and 10 columns. Rectangle Q has 6 rows and 5 columns. Which has the bigger area?
mcq.explanation: P = 3 × 10 = 30 and Q = 6 × 5 = 30. They are equal.

mcq.q: Rectangle P has 8 rows and 7 columns. Rectangle Q has 9 rows and 6 columns. Which has the bigger area?
mcq.explanation: P = 8 × 7 = 56 and Q = 9 × 6 = 54. Rectangle P has the bigger area.

mcq.q: What does area measure?
options: How much flat surface a shape covers
How much water a container holds
mcq.explanation: Area is the amount of flat surface covered by a shape.

mcq.q: How can you compare the areas of two sheets of paper without measuring?
options: Put one on top of the other and see which one sticks out
Fold both into halves and count folds only
mcq.explanation: Placing one surface on the other shows which is bigger.

mcq.q: Which unit is used for area?
mcq.explanation: Area is measured in square units, such as square centimetres (cm²).

mcq.q: Which sum finds the area of a rectangle with 4 rows and 6 columns?
mcq.explanation: Area is the number of rows multiplied by the number of columns.

mcq.q: A rectangle has 5 rows and 8 columns. How many small squares are needed to cover it?
mcq.explanation: 5 × 8 = 40 squares.

mcq.q: Which shape has the same number of rows and columns of unit squares?

mcq.explanation: A square has equal sides, so its number of rows equals its number of columns.

mcq.q: Musa covers a book cover with 12 rows of 9 squares. Which sum gives the number of squares?
mcq.explanation: Squares = rows × columns = 12 × 9 = 108.

mcq.q: A tile is 10 cm long and 10 cm wide. It is covered with 1 cm squares. How many squares fit?
mcq.explanation: 10 rows × 10 columns = 100 squares.

mcq.explanation: A = 6 × 2 × 2 = 24 blocks. B = 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 blocks. Cuboid B is greater.

mcq.q: What does volume measure?
options: The flat surface a shape covers
The space a solid object takes up
mcq.explanation: Volume is the amount of space that a solid fills.

mcq.q: Which statement about a cube is true?
options: Its length is double its width
Its length, width and height are equal
mcq.explanation: A cube has 6 equal square faces, so its length, width and height are the same.

mcq.q: A learner says the volume of a cuboid 4 by 3 by 2 blocks is 9 because 4 + 3 + 2 = 9. What is her mistake?
options: She added the numbers instead of multiplying
mcq.explanation: Volume = 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 blocks.

mcq.q: A box is 10 cm long, 10 cm wide and 10 cm high. What is its volume?
mcq.explanation: 10 × 10 = 100 per layer and 100 × 10 = 1,000 cubic centimetres.

mcq.q: A stack of soda crates has 5 crates along a wall, 4 crates deep and 4 layers high. How many crates are in the stack?
mcq.explanation: 5 × 4 = 20 crates per layer and 20 × 4 = 80 crates.

mcq.q: Which shape is a cuboid?
mcq.explanation: A matchbox has six rectangular faces, so it is a cuboid.

mcq.q: When we stack blocks to make a cuboid, what do we do first?
options: Put all the blocks in one long line only
Make one flat layer with rows and columns
Count the corners of the room
mcq.explanation: We build one layer first and then add more layers on top.

mcq.q: How many small cubes make a big cube that is 2 blocks long, 2 blocks wide and 2 blocks high?
mcq.explanation: 2 × 2 = 4 in a layer and 4 × 2 = 8 blocks.

mcq.q: The unit for volume when each block has sides of 1 cm is
mcq.explanation: Each block is one cubic centimetre, so volume is measured in cubic centimetres.

mcq.q: Why should heavy boxes be stacked at the bottom?
options: So that the stack is stable and does not fall
So that the boxes are hidden
mcq.explanation: A stack with heavy boxes at the bottom is more stable and safer.

mcq.q: How many blocks are needed to build a cube 5 blocks long, 5 blocks wide and 5 blocks high?
mcq.explanation: 5 × 5 = 25 per layer and 25 × 5 = 125 blocks.

mcq.q: How many quarter-litre containers fill 1 litre?
mcq.explanation: Four quarters make one whole, so four 1/4 L containers make 1 L.

mcq.q: How many half-litre containers fill 1 litre?
mcq.explanation: Two halves make one whole.

mcq.q: How many 5 L buckets can be filled from a 20 L jerrycan?
mcq.explanation: 20 ÷ 5 = 4 buckets.

mcq.q: How many 1/2 L bottles can be filled from 12 L of juice?
mcq.explanation: Each litre fills 2 half-litre bottles, so 12 L fills 12 × 2 = 24 bottles.
